summary: Tested all 9 items in the Production-Readiness Pillars 2-6 backend/frontend batch. Backend: 6/6 pytest assertions pass — normal login works, invalid/garbage-bytes tokens return clean 'Invalid token' 401 (no PyJWT exception leak), health-score returns all 9 categories with weight_scored_pct=100, reliability/bug_density carry caveat strings and security does NOT, heartbeat endpoint returns proper shape with both g1_route_sweep and g15_dep_scan kinds, founder-summary generate persists both views and jargon (commit_sha 'abc123', 'x.py') does NOT leak into founder_view — GET by event_id returns founder vs technical views correctly. Frontend: /admin/cockpit loads without error boundary or console errors, HealthScoreWidget renders 43/100 overall score with all 9 category rows, data-testid='health-score-caveat-reliability' and data-testid='health-score-caveat-bug_density' are present in DOM with amber warning icons, data-testid='health-score-caveat-security' is NOT present (correct), architecture-review submit button clickable — click did not crash the widget. Chat/dashboard page also loads cleanly. No blockers.
critical_code_review_comments: Nit — routers/founder_summary.py returns {"error": "not_found"} with HTTP 200 when the event_id doesn't exist; would be cleaner as HTTPException(404). Not a blocker.

Nit — cto_services/auth.py: HTTPException raised inside `except jwt.InvalidTokenError` is caught by the outer `except Exception` block for token revocation, then re-raised via `except HTTPException: raise` — behaves correctly but the control flow is subtle; a comment would help future readers.
seed_data_creation: event_summaries doc with event_id='test-run-1' was written by the founder-summary test (upsert). Left in place — safe test data, no cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (from /app/frontend/.env). All admin endpoints live under /api/aurem-dev/admin/*. Frontend AdminRoute checks localStorage 'aurem_user' JSON for is_admin/is_founder/tier=='founder' — when injecting a token via API for headless tests you MUST also seed aurem_user with is_admin:true or you'll be redirected to /dashboard. Health-score API takes ~9-10s (real live scan) — use generous timeouts. Founder-summary generate takes ~3-8s (real LLM call via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY).
